tools.basis: S1 软件参考钻头；真实设备与刀柄未批准。

safe_height_mm.basis: 软件测试明确选用历史探针参数；见 historical-parameters.json / safe_height_mm

clearance_height_mm.basis: 软件测试明确选用历史探针参数；见 historical-parameters.json / clearance_height_mm

breakthrough_mm.basis: 软件测试显式提供的附加贯穿量；不是现场卡缺项时的默认值，也不是生产推荐。

simulation.basis: Explicit numerical grid: 0.03 mm keeps the enlarged 10 x 7.5 x 1.5 mm case at 4,175,000 equivalent cells under the unchanged 5,000,000-cell local cap; other cases retain 0.025 mm. Manufacturing criteria are not altered.
